title: Canonical Proposal
description: Stored-row contract for a HITL (Human-in-the-Loop) promotion queue entry in PostgreSQL. This is not a proposal-create request schema; workspace authorization for new writes is enforced by the application role and RLS. Approved proposals become PostgreSQL graph_memories rows.

group_id.description: Tenant namespace. Migration 19 enforces strict CHECK: ^allura-[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$

workspace_id.description: Stored workspace scope added by migration 39. NULL represents a quarantined legacy row; current app writes must persist a non-empty value and are enforced by restrictive RLS.

proposal_version.description: BIGINT proposal revision serialized as a positive decimal string so JavaScript consumers do not lose integer precision. Added by migration 39; default 1 and incremented by trigger on governed proposal changes.

approved_memory_id.description: Deterministic UUID of the graph_memories row created by successful approval, or NULL before approval. Added by migration 38.

reasoning.description: Curator engine's reasoning for the score.

trace_ref.description: Foreign key to events.id (the originating trace event). ON DELETE SET NULL.

decided_at.description: Timestamp when the proposal was approved or rejected.

decided_by.description: Identifier of the person or system that made the decision (e.g., curator-cli, sabir).

witness_hash.description: SHAKE-256 hash (64-byte output) of the decision payload for audit trail integrity.

notion_synced_at.description: Timestamp when the proposal was synced to Notion.
